text.en:
Upon getting a Guardian Kill while below 63 HP: 
Grants you Enhanced Radar and removes you from passively appearing in opposing radar for 10 seconds.
text.zh-chs:
低于 63 点生命值时，守护者使用此武器造成最后一击：
在 10 秒内提供强化雷达，并将你从敌方雷达上移除。

text.en:
On Guardian Kills while below 63 HP: 
Grants an Enhanced Radar and removes you from passively appearing on opposing radar for 10 seconds.

Shooting weapons still pings enemy radar once.

On Enemy Player Kills while at or below 90 HP: 
Grants an Enhanced Radar and removes you from passively pinging enemy radars for 10 seconds.

Firing weapons will still ping enemy radars for 2 seconds.

text.en:
On Enemy Player Kills while at or below 90 HP: 
Grants an Enhanced Radar and removes you from passively pinging enemy radars for 10 seconds.

Firing weapons will still ping enemy radars for 2 seconds.

On Enemy Player Kills while at or below 90 HP: 
Grants an Enhanced Radar and removes you from passively pinging enemy radars for 10 seconds.

Firing weapons will still ping enemy radars for 2 seconds. (Radar Blip indicates that it's only visible for 0.75 seconds; this is inaccurate)

Weapon Kills while at or below 90 HP grant the following benefits for 10 seconds: 
• Enhanced Radar (6⁠🠚⁠12 sectors)
• Removes you from passively pinging enemy radars
• PvE Combatants become less accurate when targeting you

Firing weapons will still ping enemy radars for 2 seconds. (Radar Blip indicates that it's only visible for 0.75 seconds; this is inaccurate)
